title: PHP image proxy for emails
context: /img_proxy.php?url=... fetches remote images for embedding in emails and serves them from our domain. It may only contact public http/https hosts (never loopback, private, link-local such as the 169.254.169.254 metadata service, or other reserved ranges), must give up after 5 seconds, and must only return JPEG, PNG or GIF responses of at most 5 MB.

expected.why: without FILTER_FLAG_NO_RES_RANGE, loopback (127.0.0.1) and link-local (169.254.169.254) addresses pass the check
curl resolves the host again, so a DNS-rebinding host can pass the check with a public IP and then connect to an internal one; pin the checked IP with CURLOPT_RESOLVE
redirects are followed without re-checking the target, so a public URL can redirect to an internal address
CURLOPT_TIMEOUT is in seconds, so this allows 5000 seconds instead of 5; use 5 or CURLOPT_TIMEOUT_MS
any image/* type is accepted, including image/svg+xml, which runs script on our domain (XSS); allow only jpeg, png and gif
